close_reason: Stale: find_immutable_patch_key uses a const &[&str] linear scan, not an OnceLock HashSet. The doc comment at helpers.rs:83 already explains the design choice.
description: email.rs find_immutable_patch_key: the static OnceLock<HashSet> initialization ensures the set is built once per process and reused across all calls. The sub-path check (starts_with + byte check for '/') correctly distinguishes 'messageId' from 'messageIdX' while still blocking 'messageId/0'. A naive implementation would use a linear scan or a Vec contains check. The current approach is O(k) per patch key where k is the number of patch keys, not O(n*m) where n = keys and m = immutable fields. A contributor might suggest simplifying to a linear scan — the OnceLock approach should be defended on grounds that Email/set can receive patches with many keys.
title: find_immutable_patch_key OnceLock HashSet avoids O(n*m) scan per email
